stageA.coolDownPolicy: FIRST_PARTY_EQUIVALENT_AUTHORIZED; publisher login not required; original publisher Cool-down not claimed verified.

independentOutline: Start by asking learners what they observe in the unlabeled 6-column unit-key picture graph, without imposing labels.
Add travel-to-home context, discuss which labels would be plausible and why title/key constrain interpretation.
Introduce two independent representations of the same six-category data; emphasize one symbol equals one learner and 0..8 unit scale on bar chart.
Invite open questions based only on available data; do not grade ambiguous labels or learner-authored questions as numeric right/wrong.
firstPartySourceAlignedActivities: Graph warm-up with six unlabeled mathematical counts and partner response field
Teacher-mediated category context inference before showing source category names
Independent unit-key picture graph and 0..8 by-one scaled bar representation of same six values
Student-authored graph comparisons and two answerable graph questions
Independent teacher-review rubric, mathematics-community and optional centres

digitallyGradeable: Count in one named category of the fully labeled graph
Sum respondents in fully labeled graph
teacherLedNotAutoGrade: Write two own answerable graph questions
Teacher Math Community norms and lesson synthesis
stageC.numericCandidateScope: independent exact labeled category-count, total and comparison anchors only
